description: Create a scheduled event in the brand's Discord server; members see it in the Events panel and can mark themselves interested. kind external (an outside place or link: needs location AND endsAt), voice or stage (held in that kind of channel: needs channel). Optional description and a cover image. A stage event also needs Manage Channels, Mute Members and Move Members for the Hermoso role in that stage channel, which the bot does not ask for by default. Free.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

channel.description: voice or stage events: the channel id or name

discordServer.description: which Discord server (id or name) when the bot is in several

endsAt.description: ISO end time; required for an external event

imageUrl.description: a cover image: JPG, PNG or GIF

kind.description: external = somewhere outside Discord (needs location and endsAt); voice or stage = held in that kind of channel (needs channel)

location.description: external events: a place or a link, up to 100 characters

name.description: the event name, up to 100 characters

name: create_discord_event
title: Create a Discord event
